title: Circuit width-three CNF
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input variables. The width-three CNF associated to $C$ consists of the concatenation of the gate-clause lists for all gates, followed by the output clause; it is a formula on the $n$ input variables and one variable for each gate.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input variables
